description: Keep the room on time. Click the stopwatch in the rail and a timer card lands on the board. Pick 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 25 minutes, add a label and press Start: everyone on the board with Timer sees the same countdown at the top of their screen, then a soft chime or a bell. Pause, add a minute or reset from the panel or the right-click menu. Made for workshops, retros, critiques and focus sprints.
